requested_changes.body:
![low](https://www.gstatic.com/codereviewagent/low-priority.svg)

The nullable receiver `DataConnectPathSegment?` on `fieldOrThrow` and `listIndexOrThrow` can be misleading. If `this` is `null`, a `TypeCastException` is thrown, which might be unexpected. 

Changing the receiver to be non-nullable (`DataConnectPathSegment`) would clarify the function's contract: it operates on a non-null segment and throws if the type is wrong. This encourages callers to handle nullability explicitly, improving code clarity. The existing call sites in this PR already use non-null receivers, so they won't need to be changed.

```suggestion
fun DataConnectPathSegment.fieldOrThrow(): String = (this as DataConnectPathSegment.Field).field

fun DataConnectPathSegment.listIndexOrThrow(): Int =
  (this as DataConnectPathSegment.ListIndex).index
```
